 Skin looking tired? This viral Korean face mask is a shortcut to a serious overnight glow
 Beauty 
 By Chloe Burcham 
 2 hours ago Credit: @chloeburcham
 Credit: @chloeburcham
 All products on this page have been selected by the editorial team, however Stylist may make commission on some products purchased through affiliate links in this article
 2 min read
 save for later
 Make us preferred on Google
 Designed to be worn for hours, this viral hydrogel mask delivers the kind of hydration tired winter skin is crying out for.
 South Korea is often several steps ahead of the curve when it comes to skincare innovation.  K-beauty has given us everything from essences and cushion compacts to increasingly clever SPF formulas, while its focus on hydration, skin barrier support and layering lightweight formulas has helped shape how many of us approach our skincare routines today.
 But that’s not to say anything that carries a K-beauty label automatically deserves a spot on your bathroom shelf. As a beauty editor, I spend a large part of my working life testing skincare, and viral products don’t always live up to the social media hype. One that I do think is worth knowing about, however, is the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask – the hydrogel face mask you may have already seen slowly turning transparent on TikTok and Instagram.
 I won’t lie, I’m a big fan of face masks generally. I find the whole process relaxing; they force me to carve out a little bit of time to do nothing, and when my skin is feeling particularly dry or lacklustre, a good hydrating mask can make an immediate difference to how it looks and feels. And right now, with the clocks having just gone back, temperatures dropping and the central heating firmly switched on, my skin could do with all the extra hydration it can get.
 Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask
 Unlike the sheet masks you apply for 10 or 20 minutes, Biodance’s version is made from hydrogel and designed to stay on for much longer. You can wear it for around three to four hours or, if you’re comfortable doing so, leave it on overnight. As time passes, the initially opaque mask gradually becomes transparent.
 Available at Amazon, £11.99 
 buy now The formula is packed with hydrating and conditioning ingredients, including hyaluronic acid and collagen, alongside probiotic-derived ingredients. And it’s that prolonged hit of hydration that I find particularly soothing. If you’ve read any of my skincare features before, you’ll know I’m a big advocate for keeping things simple. Having previously upset my own skin barrier by throwing far too many actives at it, these days I’m much more interested in products that hydrate and support my skin than constantly trying to exfoliate or resurface it.
 This mask fits nicely into that philosophy – there’s no tingling or feeling that it’s aggressively doing something; I simply apply it to clean skin and let it get on with the job. After wearing the mask for more than three hours, the difference is immediate. My skin looks noticeably glowier and feels plump, bouncy and well hydrated. It gives you that post-facial glow – albeit without having left the sofa.
 At £11.99 for four masks, it also feels like an affordable addition to my routine. I wouldn’t use one every night – nor do I think you really need to – but as an occasional SOS treatment when my skin needs an extra hit of hydration, I’m sold.
